# RC51 — In-session source bookmarks

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc g k` / `core.toggle-bookmark` / `Toggle Bookmark`.
- Added `Esc g K` / `core.bookmarks` / `Bookmarks`.
- Added `:bookmarks`, `:bookmark-list`, and `:marks` command-line aliases for the bookmark picker.
- Bookmarks are bounded in-session source-location marks. Read-only IDE views are refused so transient context buffers do not pollute source navigation.
- The bookmark picker is searchable by path/line label; selecting a bookmark restores its buffer/file and cursor, records the origin in jump history, and reports stale file-backed targets instead of creating missing files.
- The README namespace table, navigation docs, and iPad QA matrix now cover bookmark triage.
